name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
